mintAuthority.summary: USDX is minted by Kava's x/cdp module account (minter/burner) when users draw against overcollateralized CDPs, bounded by per-collateral debt limits and an 8,723,000 USDX global debt limit. Caps and collateral params are raiseable by the 5-member Kava Stability Committee (3-of-5, 7-day proposal) and by KAVA stake governance. There is no proxy: mint logic changes via a Cosmos x/upgrade software upgrade whose authority is the gov module account, reachable by stake vote (20% quorum, 50% threshold, 33.4% veto, 7-day) and by the 1-member Kava Safety Committee holding SoftwareUpgradePermission, though enactment still requires validator binary adoption. The native Kava usdx bank denom is authored as the canonical kava/usdx deployment in the catalog and tied to the reviewed Kava x/cdp issuance route.

controls.label: Kava x/cdp module account (USDX minter)
controls.capDescription: Global debt limit 8,723,000 USDX (8723000000000 uusdx, conversion factor 6) plus 10 per-collateral debt limits and liquidation ratios enforced by x/cdp.
controls.evidence: At Kava height 22415285 on 2026-09-04, /cosmos/auth/v1beta1/module_accounts returned cdp at kava1wq9ts6l7atfn45ryxrtg4a2gwegsh3xha9e6rp with permissions [minter, burner]. /kava/cdp/v1beta1/params returned debt_param denom usdx with conversion factor 6, global_debt_limit 8723000000000 uusdx, and 10 collateral parameter sets. /cosmos/bank/v1beta1/supply/by_denom?denom=usdx returned 10013573129816 base units. The module mints USDX only on CDP draw within those bounds and cannot raise its own limit; the current usdx native deployment is the Kava x/cdp liability path.

controls.label: Kava Stability Committee (x/committee id 1)
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21631632, committee id 1 (Kava Stability Committee) is a MemberCommittee with 5 members, vote_threshold 0.5, TALLY_OPTION_FIRST_PAST_THE_POST and proposal_duration 604800s, so 3 of 5 member votes carry a proposal. Its ParamsChangePermission covers 23 keys including cdp/GlobalDebtLimit, cdp/CollateralParams and cdp/DebtParam, so it can raise the USDX debt cap without a stake vote. It holds no direct mint permission.

controls.label: Kava on-chain governance (x/gov module account)
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21631632, /cosmos/upgrade/v1beta1/authority returned kava10d07y265gmmuvt4z0w9aw880jnsr700jxh8cq5, which /cosmos/auth/v1beta1/module_accounts confirms is the gov module account. KAVA stake governance can therefore schedule x/upgrade software upgrades that rewrite x/cdp mint logic, and can change any x/cdp param including GlobalDebtLimit. Tally params: quorum 0.2, threshold 0.5, veto_threshold 0.334, voting_period 604800s. No upgrade is currently scheduled (/cosmos/upgrade/v1beta1/current_plan returned plan null).

controls.label: Kava Safety Committee (x/committee id 2)
controls.evidence: At Kava height 21631632, committee id 2 (Kava Safety Committee) is a MemberCommittee with a single member (kava1e0agyg6eug9r62fly9sls77ycjgw8ax6xk73es), vote_threshold 0.5, TALLY_OPTION_FIRST_PAST_THE_POST, proposal_duration 604800s, and SoftwareUpgradePermission as its sole permission. One member vote therefore carries a chain software-upgrade proposal that could rewrite x/cdp mint logic; enactment still requires validators to adopt the new binary.

review.evidence: Primary Kava LCD reads on 2026-09-04 at height 22415285 (chain_id kava_2222-10) identify the native USDX issuance path: x/cdp debt_param denom usdx with conversion factor 6 and global debt limit 8723000000000 uusdx; module accounts identify cdp at kava1wq9ts6l7atfn45ryxrtg4a2gwegsh3xha9e6rp with [minter, burner]; the bank supply endpoint returned 10013573129816 usdx base units; evmutil parameters expose no USDX conversion pair; send_enabled?denoms=usdx returned no override, so transfers were enabled while the governance-wired bank keeper retains MsgSetSendEnabled restriction capability. The observed native Kava issuance cannot currently be authored in the catalog because CHAIN_META.kava is type "evm" and contracts[]/tradedContracts require a 0x...40 EVM address. The authored deployment is therefore the reviewed Osmosis ibc/C78F65E1648A3DFE0BAEB6C4CDA69CC2A75437F1793C0E6386DFDA26393790AE representation, with its transfer rail reviewed under Bridge Risk.
review.reviewer: Codex CTRL batch; Kava native-control observation 2026-09-04

noLocalIssuance.rationale: USDX is observed as minted natively by the Kava x/cdp module account, but no authored local deployment can be represented in the catalog today: CHAIN_META.kava is type "evm" and both contracts[] and tradedContracts require a 0x...40 EVM address. The only authored deployment is the reviewed Osmosis IBC voucher, so Mint Authority records the observed Kava-native issuance controls without deployment refs while Bridge Risk owns the Osmosis transfer representation.
